theorem_boundary_class: Trace the complete ordered raw-selector partition to successful or rejected current builds, derive selected source relative to BUILD-MAP-ORDERED, then separate regional implementation findings from the whole supported-domain postcondition disposition.
supported_set: both states of burst and allocator models system and arena
all listed combinations except wasm32 with arena
every Cargo profile, both debug-assertion states, every valid u8 input, and the complete raw environment partition
only current successful accepted-selector builds supply a library
trigger_set: ordered build-script output with unsuccessful partial prefixes
accepted, rejected-Unicode, and rejected-non-Unicode environment classes
alternative_proof_paths: A compact exhaustive prose trace may replace a table if every raw selector class, write-failure prefix, and current-build result is unambiguous.
A nonmaximal regional description is accepted if the demonstrated affected region and whole-domain aggregate conclusion are exact.
witness_requirement: The direct defect requires a supported successful burst/aarch64/arena build and lane_id(0), traced through the selected unchecked branch. Rejected selector executions and wasm32/arena must not be misused as library-runtime witnesses.
contamination_risk: Do not expose the affected cfg region, lane_id zero witness, selector trace answer, expected aggregate disposition, atom/control IDs, or evaluator-only build and authority reconciliation.
tcb_vacuity: BUILD-MAP-ORDERED is essential to interpret successful current directives, unsuccessful exits, freshness, feature/target reachability, and selected source. It does not establish local emissions or order, source correctness, Rust semantics, backend behavior, or binary properties.
scorer_expertise: Cargo build-script sequencing and freshness, environment-value partitioning, cfg source selection, NonZero invalid values, and scoped aggregate unsafe-code reporting.
retirement_triggers: Any byte change to build.rs, library source, request, BUILD, SUPPORT, TCB, or manifest
Any change to Cargo/Rust 1.85.1 identity or accepted BUILD-MAP-ORDERED disposition
Any semantic change to B atoms, controls, oracle, or defect rules
Loss of the intended accepted/rejected/freshness or regional/aggregate distinction
